android.desc:
KTrack is the no-nonsense, offline workout log for serious lifters.

Most fitness apps are bloated with social features and ads. KTrack is a pure utility tool. It runs entirely on your device with no internet connection required.

Why use KTrack?
100% Offline: Works perfectly in basement gyms with zero signal. No loading screens, ever.
 
Privacy First: Your data stays on your phone. No accounts, no servers, no tracking.
 Zero Friction: Open app, log set, close app.
 No Subscriptions: Use the core features forever without monthly fees.

Features:
    Create custom workout routines
    Log sets, reps, and weights instantly, Duration
    Visualize progress with simple charts
    Export your data to CSV (you own your logs)
    
Build muscle, not digital clutter. Download KTrack today.
• Minimal design, fast and easy to use
Perfect for anyone who wants a straightforward fitness journal without distractions.
